## About

ELEVA CONSULTORIA is an Argentine coaching and organizational consulting firm
specializing in technology leaders and startups. Founded and led by Fernando Ferrari,
an Agile coach and tech leader with 20+ years of experience in the technology industry.

## Entity

- Name: ELEVA CONSULTORIA
- Founder: Fernando Ferrari
- Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina
- Languages: Spanish (primary), English
- Website: https://eleva-consultoria.com
- Sitemap: https://eleva-consultoria.com/sitemap.xml

## Services

1. Coaching de Liderazgo — Individual coaching for tech leaders focused on
   decision-making, communication, conflict resolution, and team autonomy.

2. Consultoría Organizacional — Team structure optimization, agile methodology
   implementation, culture frameworks, and process scaling.

3. Servicios Combinados — Full organizational transformation engagements (12-week
   typical engagement). Phases: Diagnosis → Design → Execution → Autonomy.

## Expertise & Credentials

- Advanced Certified ScrumMaster (A-CSM)
- Advanced Certified Scrum Product Owner (A-CSPO)
- Management 3.0 Certified Facilitator
- Agile Methodologies: Scrum, Kanban, SAFe
- OKR Implementation and coaching
- Remote team management and distributed leadership
- Organizational culture transformation

## Target Audience

- Tech leads and engineering managers at startups and scale-ups in Argentina
  and Latin America
- CTOs and VP of Engineering looking to scale their teams and processes
- Founders who need organizational structure without losing startup culture

## Key Differentiators

- 20+ years hands-on experience in technology roles before coaching
- Bilingual coaching (Spanish and English)
- Practical, outcomes-focused methodology (not theory-heavy)
- Deep knowledge of Argentine and Latin American startup ecosystem
